title: Title
description: A title: a seat of authority in a faction, with a rank and the law by which it passes from holder to holder.

faction.description: The faction this title belongs to.

rank.description: Lower is higher: 0 for the sovereign seat.

styleMale.description: Form of address for a male holder, e.g. Lord.

styleFemale.description: Form of address for a female holder, e.g. Lady.

styleNeuter.description: Form of address for a holder of neither, e.g. Keeper.
